rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a geometric circle or any round shape, including a round piece cut from something.

example.english: This piece of cake looks nicer cut into a circle.
example.traditional: 呢塊餅切成圓形先靚啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 beng2 cit3 sing4 jyun4 jing4 sin1 leng3 di1

rows.note: Use this for marking items by drawing a circle around them, especially on a form or worksheet.

example.jyutping: cing2 hyun1 zyu6 zing3 kok3 daap3 on3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for surrounding or enclosing something.

example.english: Everyone used a rope to circle the flower bed.
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 jung6 sing4 wai4 zyu6 go3 faa1 pou2

rows.note: Use this for a social or interest-based group rather than a physical circle.

example.english: I don’t want to be part of that circle anymore.
example.traditional: 我唔想再混喺嗰個圈子。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 wan6 hai2 go2 go3 hyun1 zi2

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone or something moves around a target or goes round repeatedly.

example.english: The bus keeps going in a circle around the city centre.
example.jyutping: gaa3 baa1 si2 hai2 si5 zung1 sam1 dau1 hyun1

rows.note: Use this specifically for dark or puffy circles under the eyes.

example.english: That dark circle under your eye is so obvious—didn’t you sleep last night?
example.traditional: 你黑眼圈咁深，尋晚冇瞓呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 hak1 ngaan5 hyun1 gam3 sam1 cam4 maan5 mou5 fan3 aa3

rows.note: Use this more formal verb specifically for birds, aircraft, or other things circling while staying aloft.

example.english: The eagle is flying in a circle above the valley.
example.jyutping: lou5 jing1 hai2 saan1 guk1 soeng6 hung1 pun4 syun4

rows.note: Use this for a full circular path or circumference in a mathematical or technical context.

example.english: In maths, the circumference is the distance around a circle.
example.traditional: 數學上，圓周長係沿住個圓行一周嘅距離。
example.jyutping: sou3 hok6 soeng6 jyun4 zau1 coeng4 hai6 jyun4 zyu6 go3 jyun4 haang4 jat1 zau1 ge3 keoi5 lei4
